disposition.reason: A bare weakening of a known conjecture whose only route in the record (the rank-five reductions) was overtaken by Ferudun's certificate.

notes: A weakening of the conjecture that isolates its hardest coefficient; it would be an arbitrary cut without a reason why the linear coefficient alone has structure, and the rank-five footholds are now theorems of Ferudun.
observation: The linear coefficient is the first coefficient the local-formula method cannot reach termwise; at rank five it needed a global certificate. Our own record holds reductions (cell reduction, per-facet identity) proved at rank five and tested nowhere else.

source.reference: Ferudun 2026, Section 9: six or more parts remain open below the top four coefficients, and the linear coefficient is where pointwise positivity of the local weights fails.

statement: For every triple with $c^{\nu}_{\lambda\mu}>0$, the coefficient of $t$ in $c^{t\nu}_{t\lambda,t\mu}$ is nonnegative.
